successors.deliverable: Reject __reorder consistently in presentation and processing field validation using actual utility IDs; retain legacy reserved names. Add failing-first model/column checks and one public rowDrag composition proving rejection before duplicate collection IDs. Run affected existing units and type validation. Reproduction: capture.cjs / checks.txt; no rendered failure claimed.

Coordinator must reconcile remaining G-15–G-29 original obligations independently, especially full focus/scroll, workload/performance, physical touch/AT and exact-artifact gates; retain required deferrals only where explicitly approved. Attach resulting evidence to M16 rather than closing it from the baseline.
